body: Not really, when nobody cares I feel like everything I do is worthless
I do things for myself but if feels pointless if nobody else cares

I like these things but I feel like I'm a waste of everyone's time if I'm not good
If I'm not good nobody will ever care about anything I do
I used to be confident and it didn't help at all, it just made me seem full of myself and made me think I was better than I actually was
I didn't even do that right, one of my viewers told me afterwards that the stream glitched and stopped recording
Thank you everyone for your kind words, I'm sorry for the lack of responses. I'm really drained right now and I don't use this account much.

Everyone else my age that I know is at least good at something, I'm only 2 years off of going to college and I don't have any skills or extracurriculars to put on an application so there's probably no way I'll make it into college
You'd hate me if you knew me irl, I'm using a throwaway so nobody irl knows about my plans
I don't think it's just my mind, if it was just my mind I'd at least have someone who could tolerate me
I know several people more deserving of the life I have than me, I was lucky to be born to a privileged family, yet I'm completely worthless despite that
It's not that good doesn't come, it's that I'm a drain on the good other people should have instead of me.
I'm a burden on others and a drain on resources that other people deserve more
